messages:
jules: kicked off a quick cross-pop latency sweep for gptx-q8 and a q4 variant. goal: measure p50/p95 across us-east/us-west/eu-west with default edge weights (80/10/10) and a simulated 90/5/5 reweight.

ida: which hardware? H100 or mixed? also: was runtime pinned across regions?

jules: H100 exclusively. runtime images might differ though. invoked bench-sim:

```
bench-sim --model gptx-q8 --pops us-east=0.8,us-west=0.1,eu-west=0.1 \
  --nodes H100 --concurrency 24 --samples 4000 --kernels=auto --warmup 1500
```

nate: initial numbers (kernels=auto, mixed runtime):
- us-east: p50 95ms, p95 1.05s
- us-west: p50 130ms, p95 2.2s
- eu-west: p50 100ms, p95 1.1s

jules: that us-west tail is wild. dug into runtime tags and found us-west still on r-2026-10-28-h100 (no fused-attn), others on r-2026-11-03-h100.

sam: not surprised. fused kernels + tiled GEMM shave a chunk off tails. on 2k context we see 15-25% p95 reduction with fused-attn.

ida: there could also be networking: our edge-proxy fleet in us-west has proxy-c (smaller SKU) and a different prefix-cache TTL. can you trace one slow request?

jules: sample hop trace (slow):
```
client -> edge-router-usw(12ms) -> proxy-c(120ms) -> infra-switch(15ms) -> infer-node(8ms)
```
fast sample in us-east:
```
client -> edge-router-use(10ms) -> infra-switch(12ms) -> infer-node(7ms)
```
proxy-c adds ~100ms under load.

nate: ok two root causes: runtime kernel mismatch and an extra/undersized proxy in us-west. re-run with unified runtime + kernel=prefer-fused.

bench-bot: re-run scheduled: 2026-11-05T03:10Z (run id 1845102)

jules: re-run results (concurrency 24, unified r-2026-11-03-h100, prefer-fused):
- us-east p50 100ms p95 1.0s
- us-west p50 115ms p95 1.18s
- eu-west p50 102ms p95 1.03s

ida: much closer but us-west still ~15% higher at p95. likely remaining ~100ms attributable to proxy-c.

sam: capacity note: if we avoid proxy-c by shifting weights to 90/5/5, us-east sees +12% concurrency. ensure H100 pool in us-east has 20% autoscale headroom to absorb.

nate: simulated 90/5/5 reweight (traffic-sim v1.3): estimated p95 change when avoiding proxy-c:
- global p95 reduces by ~6% overall, us-east p95 increases <5% under current headroom. tail variance tightens.

eval-bot: eval run: quantized q8 vs fp16 on eval-corpus-v3: top1 token match delta 0.7%, perplexity delta 0.9%. tags: quant-ok/2026-11-05

jules: action items:
- ops: either upgrade proxy-c or mark it as low-weight / maintenance (ida / @ops)
- infra: ensure runtime image parity across pops and push fused kernel images (ida)
- eng-ml: run a kernel flags matrix (auto, prefer-fused, prefer-safe) and a concurrency sweep (12,24,48) and publish p50/p95 heatmaps + CSV (jules)
- capacity: test 90/5/5 canary with autoscale headroom + rollback plan (sam)

ops-bot: ticket #INFR-4523 created to upgrade proxy-c. assigned to @ops oncall.

jules: i'll upload flamegraphs, heatmaps, and a short postmortem note to the bench board after the long-run completes. keeping this thread as ground truth for decisions.
